description: This course explores the ethical implications of emerging technologies such as AI, blockchain, and IoT within the context of professional practice. Topics include ethical frameworks like the IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous Systems, GDPR compliance, and the ACM Code of Ethics. Students will examine case studies on algorithmic bias in machine learning models, privacy concerns in IoT devices, and the ethical challenges of data mining. The course also covers professional standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 for information security, and the ethical responsibilities of software engineers in agile development environments. Ethical decision-making models, including the Trolley Problem in AI contexts, and the role of ethics committees in tech organizations will be analyzed. Students will evaluate the ethical impact of emerging technologies on society, focusing on areas like cybersecurity, digital rights, and the ethical use of big data analytics.

clos.text: Define the IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous Systems and its relevance to AI development

Evaluate the ethical responsibilities of IT professionals in agile development environments
